title: Sappy
summary: SAP'PY, adjective 1. Abounding with sap; juicy; succulent. 2. Young; not firm; weak. When he had passed this weak and sappy age - 3. Weak in intellect. SAP'PY, adjective [Gr. to putrefy.] Musty; taint
